scope: Adults aged 20 and older; conditional if exact age is unknown. Not applied to children or pregnancy.
quote:
| BMI | Category |
| --- | --- |
| 18.5 to 24.9 | Healthy weight |
| 25 to 29.9 | Overweight |
| 30+ | Obesity (including severe obesity) |
| 40+ | Severe obesity |

categories.label_vi: cân nặng trong khoảng khỏe mạnh theo bảng BMI

rounding_policy: No silent rounding; values in gaps between displayed decimal boundaries need clarification.
